scope: Direct SSE item text updates for ordinary replies, reasoning and SRE live prose; display-frame batching without a fixed 30fps ceiling.

reference.documentedBehavior: Agent message deltas update a named item; item completion is authoritative.
reference.limit: Codex desktop's private rendering scheduler and exact frame timings were not available. Lake retains its ADK runtime and uses its own compatible item update and snapshot recovery design.

behavior.liveConnection: Addressed text prefixes travel in SSE events and update only the matching card or agent run; same-frame events are batched. No per-packet full session fetch.
behavior.display: requestAnimationFrame with grapheme boundaries and existing bounded catch-up; no fixed 32ms publish throttle
behavior.history: Unchanged message, task, resource and Markdown branches retained
behavior.recovery: Unknown targets, structural changes, completion and replay use canonical snapshots; replay does not persist another copy of live text
behavior.ordering: Session, root turn, item identity and cursor checks reject stale events; final snapshot wins over queued text frames

checks.typescript: passed; also checked by final signed build
checks.reconnect: recovered via snapshot, text retained and no history replacement
checks.completion: one canonical snapshot stopped activity and displayed reply end
checks.nativeDev: installed app launched, current conversation and composer restored; no real model or resource request submitted

notes: Browser exercised the real App against synthetic fetch and SSE. Go tests used temporary stores and synthetic providers. Release app/data, permissions and existing uncommitted work were preserved.
